checks_passed.new_validator_warnings: None — same 4 notice codes in both feeds, same counts and severities. Caveat: both hosted reports (gtfs-validator 8.0.1) show ERROR-severity invalid_input_files_in_subfolder / missing_calendar_and_calendar_date_files / missing_required_file because the source zips nest all GTFS files one directory level down (e.g. Massachusetts_BOSTON_MBTA_20260715-000/) instead of at the zip root — the validator can't find calendar.txt, stops.txt, routes.txt, trips.txt, stop_times.txt, agency.txt at the top level, so it never reaches row-level content rules (expired_calendar, stop_too_far_from_shape, etc. are not present in either report as a result). This packaging defect is identical in both feeds (not introduced by this version) — no delta to flag between old and new — but it means this validator run does not confirm content-level checks the way a correctly-packaged feed would.
checks_passed.id_regeneration_required_files: trips 1.5% new IDs (1,280 of 82,725 new, 62 removed, 81,445 kept); stops 0.0% (all 10,293 identical); routes 0.0% (0 of 401 new, 1 removed — Shuttle-WonderlandAirport, 401 kept); service_id (calendar+calendar_dates union) 22.5% new (31 of 138 new, 5 removed, 107 kept) — consistent with MBTA's normal weekly service-window rollover, not ID regeneration. Threshold: 80–90%.
checks_passed.stop_code_change: 0.0% — stop_code unchanged for all 10,293 common stops (populated on 7,068, empty on 3,225 in both feeds). Threshold: >5%.
checks_passed.entity_churn: trips +1.5% net (81,507→82,725), stops 0% (10,293→10,293), routes -0.2% (402→401, single expired shuttle route removed), calendar services +23.2% net unique service_id (112→138, driven by the weekly service-window roll: new week's calendar rows added, past week's removed). Maximum single-file entity loss is 4.5% (calendar.txt, 5 of 112 rows); calendar_dates.txt swings look large in percentage terms (8 of 14 rows removed) but the file only has 14 rows total, so the ratio isn't meaningful. All well below the 20–50% floor used to flag suspicious entity loss.
checks_passed.stop_coordinate_drift: 0 stops moved at all across all 10,293 common stops — every stop_lat/stop_lon pair is byte-identical between feeds. Max shift 0.0m, mean shift 0.0m.
